dct_description_sm:
City of Fredericton 2017 General Fund Budget including Non-tax Revenue, General Revenue from Property Taxes
and the Community Funding and Equalization Grant, Service Based Expenditures, Community and Strategic Partner
Capital Grants, Capital Expenditures, Debt Service Costs, and estimates of Asset Depreciation at Fair Market Value
for 2017. This budget is presented by the eight (8) Program Results areas.
